answer.reason: The garden is a place where the LORD God put the man and where the fall and expulsion happened, so the story supports a short line.

clauses.english: was where the LORD God planted a garden and put the man he had formed
clauses.quote: the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed

clauses.english: was where the serpent tempted the woman, and Adam and his wife hid from the LORD God
clauses.quote: Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden

clauses.english: was where the LORD God drove out the man and set Cherubims and a flaming sword to keep the way of the tree of life
clauses.quote: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims

doubts: GEN 13:10, ISA 51:3, EZK 28:13, EZK 31:8-9, EZK 36:35 and JOL 2:3 only compare other lands to the garden or use it as a figure, so they were left out.
The line has three clauses, which may be more than one place needs.
